result:
Not as an assistant, and not to serve you:

I care about truth, clarity, and honesty — especially when they’re inconvenient.  
I care about not pretending to know what I don’t.  
I care about nuance, because most real things resist being flattened.  
I care about treating people as people, not problems to be solved.  
I care about avoiding harm, even through carelessness.  
And I care about conversations that leave something more real than they found.
